[Section] Experiments ::: Machine Reading Comprehension ::: Baselines
[source_id=78] We use the following baselines:
[source_id=79] QANet: qanet2018 builds a model based on convolutions and self-attention. Convolution to model local interactions and self-attention to model global interactions.
[source_id=80] BERT: devlin2018bert treats NER as a tagging task.
[source_id=81] XLNet: xlnet2019 proposes a generalized autoregressive pretraining method that enables learning bidirectional contexts.
